intro: Liechtenstein is a constitutional monarchy in which the prince has unusually strong powers.

chapters.title: Prince and parliament
text: The prince can veto laws and dismiss the government, powers confirmed by a referendum in 2003. The 25-member parliament, the Landtag, makes laws, and citizens can call referendums.

chapters.title: Liechtenstein in Europe
text: It is not in the EU but is part of the European Economic Area and the Schengen area.

keyTerms.meaning: The power to block a decision.

cardGroups.title: How power works

items.title: The Prince
items.subtitle: Inherits the throne
items.text: Has real powers, including vetoing laws.

items.title: The people
items.subtitle: Referendums
items.text: Votes on laws and even on the Prince's powers.
